rule: native FoldVisionEncoder.encode global embedding; no residue states
inputs_passed: the structure file as given (all atoms present in it), voxelised by FoldVision's own preprocessing
pose: principal-axis pose with fixed axis signs, applied to the structure file before voxelisation
pooling: masked mean over all residues of the chain
structure_coverage: every row has a structure file whose sequence equals the task sequence (see manifest/coverage.csv)
